description: ADO-TXN scope on a read/write Connection: BeginTrans; a Connection.Execute UPDATE of S of ID 1, a Command.Execute UPDATE of S of ID 2, a server keyset optimistic Recordset edit and Update of S of ID 3 and a client static batch-optimistic Recordset edit and UpdateBatch of S of ID 4 (all of them opened on the Connection before BeginTrans); the stored rows are read inside the transaction through Execute; RollbackTrans; the stored rows are read again, and independently through DAO OpenDatabase. Asks which of the four routes the transaction covers and what rolls back.
